summary: Phase 1C Stripe + Boosters + Lead Partner tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 new Stripe tests pass; 111/111 total tests pass (no regressions). minor.issue: Response returns only {ok: true} without the inquiry id — makes programmatic follow-up (e.g., linking to a Stripe checkout via sponsor_inquiry_id) impossible for unauth callers. Consider returning {id, ok}.
Returns 404 for unknown session_id (correct), but PaymentReturn frontend treats 404 as a retry and never transitions to an error state. UX: consider surfacing 404 as payment-error after 1-2 attempts.

Please verify there is a visible validation message (toast, red border, helper text).
